messages:
sam: Heads up — prepping v1.3.0 private on-prem package for a customer change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need final signoff on airgap bundle, installer image tags, and rollback plan.

gina: Quick q — does the airgap bundle include the k8s operator and the metrics sidecar? last time metrics was missing.

leo: Yes. Build output: bundle-v1.3.0-20241016.tar.gz. Images inside: redwood/runtime:1.3.0, redwood/operator:1.3.0, redwood/metrics-sidecar:0.9.2. Installer artifact: installer-v1.3.0-helm.tgz

sam: We should pin runtime default to 1.3.0 in installer values and add fallback to 1.2.7 for rollbacks. Snippet I pushed: 
```yaml
runtime:
  image: "redwood/runtime:1.3.0"
  fallback_image: "redwood/runtime:1.2.7"
```

marco: Pushed installer change to release branch and published a canary (:canary) for internal smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging at 1711005823 — smoke checks OK.

gina: Security — have we cosigned the tarball and uploaded to the customer's S3 endpoint? docs updated?

security: Signed with cosign and uploaded to s3://redwood-private/airgaps/v1.3.0. Checksums: sha256: 8f3a...e12. Command used: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/airgap bundle-v1.3.0-20241016.tar.gz`

leo: Also added verify script for offline customers: `scripts/verify-airgap.sh bundle-v1.3.0-20241016.tar.gz` — it verifies cosign signatures and image manifests.

sam: Change window: 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow. Ops will watch. Rollback criteria: if runtime P99 latency increases >20ms OR failed pods >3 for 10m, trigger rollback to runtime 1.2.7 and operator 1.2.7.

gina: Who runs rollback? @marco or oncall? we should automate if possible.

marco: I'll be oncall for the window. Prefer autopilot rollback via ops-bot for faster recovery. Need ops approval.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Autopilot rollback policy enabled for release v1.3.0. Thresholds configured. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-airgap-rollback (internal).

sam: Release notes (draft):
- On-prem airgap installer (v1.3.0)
- Offline verification script for bundle integrity
- Metrics sidecar bumped to 0.9.2
- Security: cosign-signed bundles, KMS integration
- Upgrade notes: non-blocking DB migration (see docs)

gina: Docs PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/456 — includes airgap/README.md and install-offline.md

security: Reminder — added optional `kms_key_id` param to installer values so customers can use their own KMS. Confirmed we don't force key rotation during upgrade.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled production deploy for customer-ACME at 1711091223 (tomorrow 02:00 UTC). Status: queued.

sam: Final thumbs up before we handover to ops? @team :thumbsup:

gina: :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup:

marco: :thumbsup: I'll be monitoring the oncall channel.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Monitoring rules loaded for v1.3.0 release. Will escalate to #incidents if thresholds breach.

sam: Great — leaving the deploy to ops-bot and marco. I'll cut release notes this afternoon and attach the signed bundle link in the customer handover.
